title: Emarld Armour And Tools
description: this mod adds emerald armour, tools. that give u abilites like health boost, effiency, damage, speed, and also has good armour. u can craft it using emerald and its the normal recipe to craft armour and tools but with emeralds.
body:
in this mod u get emerald armour and tools. it addes the helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots,

abilities from tools: effiency, health boost, speed, and strength boost.
(mod will get updates and this is a test try)
